name: dc-cat-3d
description: Bundle dos ícones 3D das categorias da home (theme/assets/dc-cat-3d.js)

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --legal-comments=none --banner:js='/* dc-cat-3d — ícones 3D das categorias. Bundle gerado (three.js r184 tree-shaken + models procedurais). Fonte: scripts/cat-3d/ */' --outfile=../../theme/assets/dc-cat-3d.js
scripts.preview: npm run build && mkdir -p dist && cp ../../theme/assets/dc-cat-3d.js dist/dc-cat-3d.js && node shot.js
